channel.title: Small Shop Notes
channel.description: Pricing, margins and numbers for one-person online shops.

item.title: How Dimensional Weight Changes Your Shipping Cost
item.description: USPS can price a light parcel as if it were heavy when the box is large. See the dimensional weight rule, the 139 divisor, and how box size moves cost.

item.title: What Card Processing Fees Really Cost a Small Shop
item.description: A percentage plus a fixed fee hits small orders harder than big ones. See the real effective rate on $12, $60, and $250 sales using published pricing.

item.title: FIFO vs Average Cost: How Inventory Method Changes Your Profit
item.description: How the IRS-recognized FIFO and average cost inventory methods produce different taxable profit on the same sales, shown with a worked example.

item.title: Margin vs Markup, the Mistake That Costs Money
item.description: Why confusing profit margin with markup leads small shop owners to underprice their products, shown with the exact math for both terms.

item.title: Pricing a First Product, Step by Step
item.description: A step-by-step pricing framework for a first product that accounts for landed cost, selling-platform fees, and a target margin, with the math shown.

item.title: When a Discount Loses You Money, the Break-Even Math
item.description: How to use the SBA's own break-even formula to check whether a sale price actually makes a small shop money or quietly erases its margin.
